title: Closed-immersion finite-twist presentation with eventually acyclic middle term
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring, i : X → P^N_A a closed immersion, F a quasi-coherent finitely presented module on X, and q > 0. There is a short exact complex S on P^N_A whose third term is isomorphic to i_*F and whose first term is quasi-coherent and finitely presented. There is a natural b such that H^q(P^N_A, S.X₂ tensor O(t)) = 0 for every natural t ≥ b. Cohomology means module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]; O(t) is [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. No cohomology vanishing hypothesis on the first term is assumed.

source.place: https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01YS, proof of (1) and (4), finite-twist presentation and vanishing of the left term; read online 2026-10-13

proof.text: Use import all of ProjectiveFiniteCohomologyPresentation to reuse its proved private coherent-pushforward and finite-twist-epimorphism lemmas without importing the cyclic Serre module. Let S be the kernel sequence of that epimorphism. Bound the finitely many natural negative-twist indices by b. For t ≥ b, each summand after tensoring with O(t) is O(t-m_j) with t-m_j ≥ 0. Apply nonnegative-twist vanishing and the source comparison to get ordinary cohomology vanishing for each summand. Ordinary H is additive for finite sums, and tensorRight preserves coproducts. Thus the twisted middle term has zero ordinary cohomology, and the source comparison gives IsZero in module cohomology.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_twist_acyclic_presentation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ S : ShortComplex (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))).Modules,
      S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ (pushforward i).obj F) ∧
      S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent ∧ S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      ∃ b : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, b ≤ t →
        IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))).toRingedSpace q).obj
          (tensorObj S.X₂
            (ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1))) (Spec (.of A)) t)))
